Your Library Folder Structure

Keep index.html and every book file together inside one single folder on your phone or computer:

  1. Whenever you add or edit a book in Manage Books, click Export Updated index.html below and replace the old index.html in your folder.
  2. Copy your new book file (for example, the-quiet-after-you.html or any .pdf) into that exact same folder, matching the filename entered in Author Studio.
  3. Keep the Same Permanent Link on Netlify: Sign in to Netlify, open your existing site, go to the Deploys tab, and drag-and-drop your updated folder onto the deploy dropzone. Your link stays identical—never create a brand-new site.
  4. GitHub Pages Alternative: Upload the updated index.html and new book files to the root of your repository and commit; your live link refreshes automatically within a minute.
